extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: motor yacht with flybridge, approx. 19.2 x 5.0 x 10.2 m (L x W x H incl. swim platform and hardtop)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 1.0 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling; swim platform just above the waterline); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: yacht_propeller_port / _starboard (spin around the shafts), yacht_rudder_port / _starboard (turn around Z); opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no name, no flag

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
